errors.text_span: vom ersten Quartal 2020 bis zum dritten Quartal 2023. Die x-Achse ist linear skaliert und stellt quartalsweise Zeiträume dar, beginnend bei 2020 Q1 und endend bei 2023 Q3.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the x-axis represents quarterly periods. The tick marks on the x-axis clearly represent monthly intervals, not quarterly ones.

errors.text_span: Die y-Achse ist durch vertikale Linien aufgeteilt und zeigt zwei unterschiedliche Skalen an
errors.evidence: The phrasing 'divided by vertical lines' is an awkward and unclear way to describe a chart with two y-axes (a left and a right scale).

errors.text_span: Die linke Skala reicht von -200 bis 400
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states the range of the left y-axis. The figure shows the left scale ('linke Skala') ranges from 0 to 400.

errors.text_span: die rechte Skala reicht von -100 bis 400
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states the range of the right y-axis. The figure shows the right scale ('rechte Skala') ranges from -200 to 400.
The description incorrectly identifies the bars representing the trade balance ('Handelsbilanz') as horizontal. They are vertical bars.

errors.text_span: Die Exporte werden durch eine durchgezogene blaue Linie dargestellt
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps the data series to the lines. Exports ('Exporte') are represented by the purple line, not the blue line. The blue line represents imports ('Importe').

errors.text_span: die bei 150 Milliarden US-Dollar im ersten Quartal 2020 beginnt und im dritten Quartal 2023 bei 350 Milliarden US-Dollar endet
errors.evidence: Due to the incorrect line mapping, the reported start and end values for exports are wrong. Exports (the purple line) actually start at approx. 130 billion and end at approx. 180 billion USD.

errors.text_span: Die Importe werden durch eine durchgezogene braune Linie dargestellt
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps the data series to the lines and misidentifies the color. Imports ('Importe') are represented by the blue line, and the other line is purple, not brown.

errors.text_span: die bei 200 Milliarden US-Dollar im ersten Quartal 2020 beginnt und im dritten Quartal 2023 bei 330 Milliarden US-Dollar endet
errors.evidence: Due to the incorrect line mapping, the reported start and end values for imports are wrong. The description provides values for the purple line (exports) while claiming they are for imports. Imports (the blue line) actually start at approx. 200 billion and end at approx. 340-350 billion USD, so the end value is also inaccurate.

errors.text_span: mit einem minimalen Wert von -190 Milliarden US-Dollar im zweiten Quartal 2022
errors.evidence: The description misidentifies both the value and the time of the minimum for the trade balance. The minimum value occurs in late 2023 (not Q2 2022) and is approximately -180 billion USD. The value in Q2 2022 is around -130 billion USD.

errors.text_span: und einem maximalen Wert von 190 Milliarden US-Dollar im ersten Quartal 2021
errors.evidence: The description reports a positive maximum value for the trade balance, but the chart shows that the trade balance is always negative. The actual maximum value (least negative) is approximately -50 billion USD.
